scripts.build:packed-app: npm run build:lib && npm run prepare:packed-lib && npm run build:selective-example && vite build --config test/library-consumer/vite.packed-app.config.mjs && node scripts/packed-app-artifacts.mjs /tmp/ditherer-packed-app-build
scripts.test:lib: npm run build:lib && npm run prepare:packed-lib && tsc --noEmit -p examples/filter-library/tsconfig.json && node examples/filter-library/exports-smoke.mjs && npm run build:selective-example && playwright test test/e2e/library-package.spec.ts --config=test/library-consumer/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.lint: eslint src test scripts examples/filter-library/src packages/ditherer-filters/src packages/ditherer-filters/vite.config.ts vite.config.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src test scripts packages/ditherer-filters/src packages/ditherer-filters/vite.config.ts vite.config.js --fix
scripts.test:coverage:browser: node scripts/clean-browser-coverage.mjs && env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR COLLECT_BROWSER_COVERAGE=1 playwright test test/e2e/gl.smoke.spec.ts test/e2e/nc-parity.spec.ts test/e2e/wasm.smoke.spec.ts test/e2e/testMediaShare.spec.ts test/e2e/app.workflow.spec.ts test/e2e/app.advanced.spec.ts test/e2e/app.boundaries.spec.ts test/e2e/source-ingestion.spec.ts test/e2e/project-state.spec.ts test/e2e/export-artifacts.spec.ts test/e2e/ux-workbench.spec.ts test/e2e/vj-mode.spec.ts test/e2e/control-inputs.spec.ts test/e2e/library-discovery.spec.ts test/e2e/resilience.spec.ts test/e2e/workspace-layout.spec.ts test/e2e/audio-inputs.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:coverage:gate: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:coverage:browser && npm run coverage:merge
scripts.test:e2e:wasm: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test test/e2e/wasm.smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:gl: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test test/e2e/gl.smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:webmcp: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_WEBMCP=1 playwright test test/e2e/webmcp.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.check: npm --prefix packages/ditherer-filters run generate:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:packed-app && npm run build
